## Profile

Afthyir builds web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node.js, and uses Python for scripting and backend work. The stated interface styling tool is Tailwind CSS. Stated data and backend services include MongoDB, Redis and Supabase. Stated deployment platforms include Vercel and Railway.

Afthyir is also learning networking, Linux and security fundamentals, with an interest in secure-by-design software development.
